name: claude-mem
description: Persistent session memory (SQLite + Chroma + a Bun worker). Optional: WorkPilot's own three memories plus the mem-search skill cover the same ground without a fourth store.

bootstrap.note: Opt-in. WorkPilot already keeps three memories — task_logger captures, graphiti holds the graph, learning_loop distils — and claude-mem would add a fourth with its own Bun worker, SQLite file and Chroma store. What it gets right is its three-layer retrieval, and that is a query shape rather than a dependency: the `mem-search` skill implements it over the stores already here. Declared so anyone running Claude Code without the WorkPilot backend can have the real thing with `skills:bootstrap --pack claude-mem`. Vendored by git clone like the other upstream packs — see scripts/vendor_pack.py for why `npx skills add` cannot be the fetcher.
